items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: The Lloyd takes it, run over it, you know, he could play it.

ctx.x: And the second one bought a saxophone in the Orleans was Sam Dutri. All right. Well, I was the third one bought a saxophone. Well, I was out to Louie's wake at his 12 o'clock hour. Goes there. Louie. I said, I bought a saxophone. Yeah. I said, but I told a man I have the money for it, but I told him I'd be back to see it. I said, all right, I'll go along with you if I have time. Let's go look at it. He comes, look at the saxophone. He says, he wants $60 for it. Yeah. I said, I have the $60 I borrowed from Mr. Van…
This is in the early 1920s, in other words.
